snippet.title: Announcing MEGANAUT Demo | Your Floating Nightmare Begins
snippet.description:
PLAY THE DEMO NOW! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3610500/MEGANAUT/

MEGANAUT is a 3rd person narrative horror game with modernized retro 3D graphics, and unique floating mechanics. Travel past The Habitat walls into the deep megastructure in search of your missing friend Seija, and find out why he left.

Features:
- Float through a mysterious megastructure with 6 degrees of freedom
- Thick with oppressive and creepy atmosphere
- Simple environmental puzzles that don't take you out of the atmosphere
- Some jump scares ;)
- Discover deep lore beyond the main story arc
- Concise experience, roughly 2-3 hours of play time
